character.appendages: Two raised front/upper ends and a long rear element vary with facing. Do not add legs, antennae, gears or extra articulated joints; preserve existing endpoint direction and screen-relative path.
character.contactAndOrigin: Fixed per-character NCER origin[24,38] on64px canvas. Native scale1. No per-frame center/fit. Preserve each slot native bounds and every proven canonical translation. Sub aliases reuse Main without independent generation.
character.faceAndExpression: Track visibility, compression and expansion of the colored front/lower regions. Side cells002/003/051 hide front markings. Organ identity and emotion labels are unproven, so preserve visible expression geometry without inventing eyes/mouth where hidden.
character.locomotion: Whole-body tilt/rotation and low/high side/front changes. No articulated legs. Vertical rotation09/63 and raised appendage10 must not be turned into a generic hop or walk cycle.
character.morphology: Species009 / m002_choromon, generation1, familyBits0. Visually small mechanical-looking shell with raised ends and long rear component; no evidenced biped/quadruped gait. Do not relabel familyBits0 as Machine family.
character.restraint: Main027..043 show gold wrap around trunk/rear body in all repeated pose variants. Bindings must remain attached, change angle with shell and survive flattened states. All source sequences16..25 retained.
